document: OptionPilot Pro — 12 Advanced Diagnostic Points — Rigorous Codebase Examination
method: Every finding below was verified by reading server.ts directly (grep + line inspection), not recalled from memory. No code was changed for this examination.
major_finding: IV, Delta, Theta, Vega are ALREADY computed for EVERY strike (ATM±10 for NIFTY/SENSEX, ATM±6 for BankNifty) across ALL 4 expiries (Current/Next/Next-of-Next/Monthly), and already sent to the client as part of each expiry's ceStrikes/peStrikes arrays. This is a much stronger foundation than assumed earlier today — most of these 12 points need only NEW COMPUTATION/AGGREGATION logic, not new Kite data fetches.

points.name: Volatility Regime Engine
points.have: Spot change, ATM IV (all 4 expiries), VIX + VIX change, Straddle state (Step 6A) — all already available.
points.missing: Realized volatility — needs a rolling historical daily-return series, which does not exist anywhere in this codebase (only intraday snapshots + 1-day PDH/PDL).
points.buildable_now: Volatility expansion/compression/stable classification using IV+VIX+Straddle only (skip realized vol, or approximate later).

points.name: IV–Intrinsic–Extrinsic Cause Detector
points.have: Premium, Intrinsic (computeIntrinsicValue), Extrinsic, IV, Spot — ALL already available for every strike/expiry.
points.missing: Nothing data-wise. Just needs the classification logic (spot-driven vs volatility-supported vs mixed) written.
points.buildable_now: Yes, immediately, ATM±3 across all 4 expiries, no new data needed.

points.name: CE–PE Volatility Battle / IV Skew
points.have: CE IV and PE IV both already computed per strike per expiry. Skew = CE_IV − PE_IV is a one-line calculation.

points.name: IV Term-Structure Shock Detector
points.have: ATM IV for Current/Next/Next-of-Next/Monthly all directly readable from m.expiries[0..3].
points.missing: Nothing for a single-snapshot term structure. A 'shock' (sudden change) needs a previous-value comparison — same tracker pattern already used elsewhere (own key namespace, stateless-safe).

points.name: Premium Migration
points.have: Premium/Intrinsic/Extrinsic/IV across all 4 expiries, single snapshot.
points.missing: 'Migration' implies a TIME dimension (is premium concentration shifting toward later expiries over time) — needs a new per-expiry historical tracker; the just-built Premium Diagnostic 15-min buffer is a reusable template for this, currently NIFTY/current-week/ATM only.

points.name: OI + IV Matrix
points.have: OI, IV, Volume, Premium — all current-snapshot values available.
points.missing: OI change / IV change need a previous-value reference. The existing chain-level intrinsic arrow tracker (added earlier today, '_chainintrinsic_' namespace) is a direct template — same pattern extends cleanly to IV/OI with a new, separate key namespace.

points.name: Straddle–IV Divergence
points.have: ATM CE/PE premium, Step 6A's straddleState, ATM IV, spot movement — available.
points.missing: 'Divergence' needs straddle-vs-IV trend comparison over time — same tracker-extension need as points 5/6.

points.name: Volatility Compression → Expansion Detector
points.have: 3-min Recorder snapshots exist, but do NOT include IV/theta/vega/straddle — checked RecorderIndexSnapshot directly, it only has spot/PDH-PDL/VWAP/futures LTP+OI/ATM CE+PE LTP+OI.
points.missing: Sequential IV/straddle history. Two options: (a) extend RecorderIndexSnapshot with IV/straddle fields (small, safe addition, mirrors existing fields), or (b) reuse/extend the just-built Premium Diagnostic 15-min buffer (already collects this per-snapshot, just needs the fields added and a compression/expansion classifier on top).
points.note: The spec's own 'avoid future leakage' rule is already satisfied by design in the 15-min buffer pattern (only completed windows are diagnosed).

points.name: Time-Decay Pressure Map
points.have: Extrinsic value/%, Theta, DTE (computeDaysToExpiry), IV — ALL already available per strike per expiry. This is essentially the same data already used in the existing Premium Diagnostic card (chapter 03).
points.missing: Nothing. Just needs the decay-exposure classification extended across ATM±3 and all 4 expiries instead of ATM-only.

points.name: Premium Quality / Composition
points.have: Intrinsic %, Extrinsic % already computed. Intrinsic-heavy/Extrinsic-heavy/Balanced is a trivial threshold classification on top.
points.missing: Nothing. Easiest point on the list to fully implement.

points.name: Multi-Expiry Agreement Engine
points.have: Intrinsic/Extrinsic/IV/OI/Volume all available across all 4 expiries for a single snapshot — single-snapshot agreement/divergence IS buildable now.
points.missing: Skew comparison needs point 3 built first (trivial). 'Agreement over time' (not just this instant) needs the same historical tracker extension as points 5/6/7.

points.name: Market Story vs Option Story
points.have: Market-story signals (spot/futures/OI/PCR/VIX/sector/gap/structure) are ALL already computed elsewhere in the codebase and reusable via lastRuleEngineResult contributions (same pattern already used in the existing Premium Diagnostic Layer, chapter 03) — no new stateful calls needed. Option-story signals depend on points 2–10 above.
points.missing: This is a synthesis/aggregation layer over the other 11 points — should be built LAST, after those exist.

cross_cutting_findings: 6 of 12 points (2, 3, 4, 9, 10, and the single-snapshot part of 12) are buildable IMMEDIATELY with zero new data — only new computation/aggregation logic on data already fetched and already sent to the client.

6 of 12 points (1 partially, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11 partially) need a NEW historical/time-series tracking layer for 'change over time' or 'divergence' — this does not exist yet for IV/Greeks/straddle (only for LTP/OI, and only for ATM/current-week in the just-built Premium Diagnostic 15-min buffer).

The just-built Premium Diagnostic 15-min window infrastructure (buffer + scheduler + Haiku call, NIFTY-pilot) is DIRECTLY reusable as the historical-tracking foundation these 6 points need — recommend extending IT rather than building a second, parallel history mechanism.

Realized Volatility (point 1) is the one item with no existing foundation at all and no obvious reuse path — would need a genuinely new daily-return calculation from stored daily closes, which aren't tracked long-term either (no database, resets on redeploy, same disclosed limitation as Recorder/Outcome Engine all day today).
recommended_build_order: Phase A (no new data, build immediately): Points 2, 3, 4 (single-snapshot), 9, 10 — pure aggregation of already-available IV/Greeks/Intrinsic/Extrinsic across ATM±3 and all 4 expiries.

Phase B (extend the existing 15-min buffer with IV/OI/straddle fields): Points 1 (partial), 5, 6, 7, 8, 4 (shock/change part), 11 (time part) — all share the same missing ingredient (historical IV/Greeks/straddle series) and the same reusable infrastructure.
Phase C (synthesis, build last): Point 12, combining Phase A + Phase B outputs with existing market-story signals.
hard_rules_preserved: None of this touches runRuleEngine(), scoring, verdict, or confidence — confirmed, no changes proposed to those functions.
All 12 points remain 'score: 0, status: Diagnostic only' per the spec's own final_rule — not proposing to add scoring weight.

Per the user's explicit correction to the spec's own default ('we will not observe it, we will add it'): this report treats 'add' as 'implement the diagnostic layer in code, as a real feature' — not merely produce a written explanation — while still respecting the spec's separate, unrelated rule about not adding these to the deterministic score.
final_instruction_needed_from_user: Confirm Phase A / B / C build order, or specify a different starting subset, before any code is written.
